notes.title: Ancient Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Ancient update is live![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11911069/73624cf48701886e06c7675f1889112120c7dffc.png[/img]

New Ancient levels, achievements and enemies!

[b]Adds[/b]
[list]
[*]New Ancient level tiers
[*]New versions of old levels added to level pool
[*]Three new flower enemies
[*]New achievements
[*]New item: Lure, projectile that attracts all moving enemies towards it
[/list]

[b]Fixes & Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased player default acceleration
[*]Fixed player animation bug when exiting shuttle
[*]Fixed some audio issues
[*]Improved moving turkey: Added longer delay before attacking
[*]Tweaks to vaccine machine: Reduced breaking chance, Increased item drop rates
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 5
notes.content:
[b]Adds[/b]
[list]
[*]Added darkness music
[*]Added bossfight music
[*]Added manual reloading
[list]
[*](You may have to rebind this in options, if using custom mappings)
[*]Removed non-directional attacking
[/list]
[*]Added new levels that might appear during run
[*]Added more item visuals for characters
[*]Added new enemy variations
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed shuttle door opening delay on home scene
[*]Fixed progress bar staying above black screen after exiting store
[*]Fixed issue where player could die when entering shuttle and breaking game
[*]Fixed some audio effects being too loud and not affected by options volume
[*]Fixed issue where player reload indicator wasn't displaying correct time
[*]Fixed Vaccine Machine info not displayed correctly
[*]Fixed some cases where enemies could travel through boxes
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed Antidepressant to Legendary tier
[*]Added info how to unlock characters
[*]Changed how music is played through game
[*]Changed how invulnerability items work with new manual reloading
[*]Reduced level change time
[*]Reduced Bob and Bill reload time
[*]Added info how to unlock characters
[*]Changed enemy spawns on many levels
[*]Reduced Lightning bee movement speed
[*]Increased Gloomshroom attack delay slightly
[*]Increased Porcupine attack delay slightly
[*]Reduced Slimey health
[*]Increased vaccine drops from chests
[*]Reduced Porcupine projectile speed
[*]Nerfed some waves on some levels
[/list]

Townforest
[img]http://fatu.kapsi.fi/townforest.png[/img]

For next update we're working with new content and some gameplay changes. We're thinking of changing diagonal attacking to be more easy, but still a bit unsure how that will affect the overall balance of the game. We have heard your feedback of this, but would like to hear a bit more. Would you like to have easier diagonal shooting, keeping it same, or no diagonal shooting at all?

That's all for now, have a good one!

notes.title: Status update
notes.content:
Hey guys and gals!

We've been smashing bugs and adding final touch for the game before Tuesdays launch and it's going great! We'll be updating game with the release version, sometime tomorrow for those of you already owning the game.

In the meanwhile have a look at our new [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ScIyrhElNl4]gameplay trailer[/url] and let us know what you think!

Get hyped!

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 22
notes.content:
Combination of changes and fixes happened this week

[img=http://sieidi.com/media/spoopy.png]Spoopy in action[/img]

[b]Adds[/b]
[list]
[*]Spoopy and Billy are now unlockable
[*]Added new levels
[*]Added new monsters
[*]Added effects for items
[*]Added option to enable/disable Screenshake
[*]Added option to adjust SFX volume
[*]Added option to adjust Music volume
[*]Added background music
[*]Added "New character unlocked" window to be displayed when player unlocks character
[*]Added pink outline for player when invulnerable
[*]Added two second delay before player is able to pickup item drops, to prevent accidentaly picking up items
[*]Added new item tier: Legendary
[*]Added some lore when player dies
[*]Added stun effect for enemies 
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where respawn cost on respawn window wasn't always visible
[*]Fixed issue where weapon recharge was always set to max recharge when taking damage
[*]Fixed colliders on levels
[*]Fixed Nuttinger staying visible after jumping 
[*]Fixed issue where Vaccine machine didn't always drop stuff on leveling
[*]Fixed issue where Vaccine machine didn't break
[*]Fixed issue where wooden creates weren't destroyable
[*]Fixed item Beans not working
[*]Fixed issue where recharge drop gave vaccine instead of bullets
[*]Fixed issue where player was able to continue playing while key mapping screen was visible
[*]Fixed issue where Rocksolid wasn't disabled when player was moving
[*]Fixed issue where player was given empty item
[*]Fixed issue where Apple effect stayed visible on screen
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Balancing enemies and levels
[*]Removed "XP" from store prices
[*]Changed level pool ordering
[*]Tweaked Billy and Spoopy base values
[*]Treasure chests item drop chance increased
[*]Changed character panels texts to say "LOCKED" if player hasn't unlocked character yet
[*]Changed Nuttinger AI
[*]Changed HUD scaling
[*]Changed Vaccine machine spawn positions
[*]Disabled Vaccine machine collider
[*]Changed Graphics options name to Settings
[*]Changed enemy spawnpoints on levels
[*]Changed "Press Use to View" to "Press Use to select" when selecting character
[*]Changed Hydrocortisone to Legendary tier
[*]Changed Scatter Shot to Legendary tier
[*]Changed Side Effect to Epic tier
[*]Increased Lobotomy min and max damage
[/list]
